instruction: Execute complete HANDOFF.md once after dedup and local claimed. Generate around ten or more meaningful candidates, no count cap or hard minimum. Independent worktree at fixed implementation. Preserve contracts and budget protections. Use only original configured local metered model/planner and existing ledgers. Cached inputs only; stop at prepared_instances and report. Do not rerun query generation/retrieval/download/PDF/Docling/formula/simulation/full regression or add model review.

budget.model_call_scope: one generation plus at most one contract repair
budget.reservation: Original wrapper must reserve using confirmed actual model prices and identical input/output token bounds. Any unknown cap, price, unsettled status or wrapper coverage: blocked, no bare call.

expected_outputs: Actual candidate count, structural/parameter changes, evidence type and comparative expectations
Raw responses, contracts, prepared inputs, route_quality_report, repair changes and redacted cost summary
Near-duplicate and s/p phase explanation recurrence analysis; meaningful same-structure variants retained
Truncation/interruption clearly partial, never a complete candidate set; performance remains unsimulated

execution.entrypoint: route_stage.main(..., planner=original metered local planner injection)
execution.input: Original T022 task_sheet/design_constraints/12 evidence_items; existing T024 accepted five exports
execution.evidence: Keep original12; use existing material_evidence index/selection interfaces for useful whole CORE blocks. Do not guess IDs or truncate text. Report if unavailable.
execution.output_limit_rule: Verify actual model support and matching wrapper reservation first; otherwise use a confirmed larger supported limit and report. Preserve context/output/cost protections.
execution.local_wiring: Only simple native-wrapper local test wiring per HANDOFF; no rewritten model loop or unvalidated cloud adapter.

cloud_validation: 297 offline tests + 6 subtests, sockets disabled; 12 routes/24 instances without clipping, tail constraints checked, explicit truncation rejected as complete. No real API test claimed.
scientific_quality: pending real generation; count and contract pass alone are not scientific improvement
user_instruction: 对候选方案的数量不做限制，鼓励10条左右及以上。
